In the second half [[Lar Corbett]] and [[JJ Delaney]] were sent off in the 46th minute after they wrestled each other on the ground near the Kilkenny goal. {{cite web|url= http://www.rte.ie/sport/gaa/hurling/2013/0505/390493-kilkenny-v-tipperary/|title= Kilkenny 2-17 Tipperary 0-20|date=5 May 2013|work=RTÉ Sport|access-date=13 May 2013 }}{{cite web|url= http://www.hoganstand.com/kilkenny/ArticleForm.aspx?ID=191536 |title= HL1 final: Fennelly double downs Tipp|date=5 May 2013|work=Hogan Stand|access-date=13 May 2013 }} On 13 May Kilkenny's [[Lester Ryan (hurler born 1988)|Lester Ryan]] was named as the GAA-GPA Hurler of the League for 2013. Ryan scored 1–10 in six games from midfield including 0–3 in the semi-final win over [[Galway GAA|Galway]] and 0–3 in the final victory against [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]]. {{cite web|url= http://www.irishexaminer.com/breakingnews/sport/oneill-and-ryan-win-league-awards-594264.html|title=O'Neill and Ryan win League awards|date=13 May 2013|work=Irish Examiner|access-date=14 May 2013 }}{{cite web|url=http://www.kilkennypeople.ie/sport/gaelic-games/ryan-relished-home-final-1-5083002|title=Ryan relished 'home' final|date=14 May 2013|work=Kilkenny People|access-date=14 May 2013|archive-date=4 July 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130704054418/http://www.kilkennypeople.ie/sport/gaelic-games/ryan-relished-home-final-1-5083002|url-status=dead}}{{cite web|url= http://www.hoganstand.com/ArticleForm.aspx?ID=192163|title=Awards for O'Neill and Ryan|date=13 May 2013|work=Hogan Stand|access-date=14 May 2013 }} ==Format== *'''Division 1A:''' Top three teams qualify for NHL semi-finals. Bottom two teams play a relegation playoff, with the losing team relegated. *'''Division 1B:''' Top two teams play division final, with the winner being promoted and qualifying for NHL semi-final. Bottom two teams play a relegation playoff, with the losing team relegated. *'''Divisions 2A''' and '''3A:''' Top two teams play division final, with the winner being promoted. Bottom two teams play a relegation playoff, with the losing team relegated. *'''Divisions 2B:''' Top two teams play division final, with the winner being promoted. Bottom team relegated. *'''Division 3B:''' Top two teams play division final, with the winner being promoted.
